description: Explicit runtime authentication mode for every deployed Supabase Edge Function. verify_jwt is kept in sync with the CLI config and point-in-time live inventory.

agent-execute.rationale: Requires a valid Supabase JWT; handler performs its own authorization.

evidence-graph.rationale: Supabase server adapter enforces auth=user and handler requires userClaims.sub.

intel-feed.rationale: Public GET-only Hacker News industry feed; no privileged database writes.

market-price.rationale: Public GET-only stock/ETF quote proxy; dormant (configured:false) until TWELVE_DATA_API_KEY is set; no privileged database access.

notify-access.rationale: Called by the database through pg_net, never by a member. Requires x-omega-webhook-secret to match the Vault secret notify_access_webhook_secret, read through the server-only RPC public.omega_notify_access_secret(); rejects any other caller with 401 (migration 20261025100000).

rankings.rationale: Authenticated member leaderboard; caller rank derives only from the verified JWT, body user_id is never trusted.

snapshot-leaderboard.rationale: Owner-only on-demand snapshot; the function re-checks profiles.is_owner. The service-key bearer path was removed before deploy (not timing-safe).

stripe-webhook.rationale: Webhook authenticates using Stripe's signed raw request body; Supabase JWT verification is not the webhook trust boundary.
